definitions: The application of Bayesian statistical methods to calibrate models, often involving the use of prior information and observed data to update model parameters and quantify uncertainties.
A specific project or task focused on adjusting model parameters using Bayesian inference to improve the model's accuracy and predictive capabilities.
examples: The team presented their latest Bayesian calibration work at the conference.
Significant Bayesian calibration work was required for the climate model.
Her dissertation involved extensive Bayesian calibration work on a complex engineering system.
